Professional Summary
Senior financial analyst with strong expertise in budgeting, forecasting, and financial planning. Proven track record of delivering actionable FP&A insights, building robust financial models, and streamlining reporting processes using SAP FICO and Microsoft Excel. Comfortable working in cross-functional teams and automating repeatable tasks.

Financial Modelling, FP&A, Microsoft Excel, SAP FICO, Linux, Git

- Built scenario-driven Financial Modelling tools to evaluate pricing and cost levers for strategic initiatives, supporting a business case that improved margin by 3%.
- Collaborated with IT to version-control reporting templates and scripts using Git and leveraged Linux-based automation to generate recurring reports.

FP&A Manager, PhonePe (Jun 2018 - Nov 2019)
- Managed monthly and quarterly FP&A processes, producing board-ready decks and dashboards using Microsoft Excel and Financial Modelling techniques.
- Designed and maintained SAP FICO-based reporting structures to ensure accurate P&L and balance sheet reconciliations across product lines.
- Created driver-based Financial Modelling to forecast user monetization scenarios; enabled prioritization of product investments that increased contribution per user.
- Introduced Git workflow for tracking changes in complex Excel models and used Linux scripts to automate data ingestion from operational systems.
